besluite.rede: The second clause has its own subject (Langa) with the verb gapped, so the comma marks the contrast between the two people and is acceptable; removing it puts two 'en's close together ('aktivis en skrywer gedoen en Langa') and makes a first reading harder, not easier.

besluite.fout: 'bly' does not say the person is held there against their will, so the entry read on its own could suggest a choice to stay alone.
besluite.rede: The point is real, but this is a [begrip] definition, the proposal adds meaning (being held by someone) and costs a word in a lesson at its ceiling, so the writer must decide the fix.
